about: What NPCs fight with beyond the levels in their cache types. Speeds, max hits, attack styles, bonuses and respawn times are the OSRS Wiki infoboxes' (read 2026-10-26), cross-checked with the Wiki's DPS calculator data (weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc monsters.json). Animations are gameval names: attack and death are the NPC's own by name; which of an NPC's block or def animations it defends with is guessed.
